title: GET /api/display/v1/frame — the photo screensaver's round
description: Photos from the household albums an admin picked (only albums everyone at home sees). 404 FRAME_OFF while the screensaver is off, 409 NIGHT in the night window, 423 while locked. The same round all day.

interval_s.description: How long each photo stays before the next one.

fade_ms.description: The crossfade into the next photo (the browser cuts without fading under reduced motion).

image.description: The screen each photo's url is fitted into (the default 1280 × 800; ask url?w=&h= for another).

url.description: The photo as a PNG fitted into image (aspect kept, never enlarged), drawn from the stored WebP; append ?w=&h= (200–1920 × 200–1200) for the panel's own screen. ETag → 304.

width.description: The PNG's width at the default image size.

date.description: The day it was taken (else uploaded), in the wall's language — shown small with the album.

album.description: Its album's name, in the wall's language for the feed's and the default album.
